lines.text: David takes refuge in the LORD, calls Him his rock and fortress, and commits his spirit into His hands.
David rejoices in the LORD's loving devotion because the LORD has seen his affliction and set his feet in the open.
David's sorrow makes his eyes fail, his friends welcome him on the street, and enemies plot to take his life.

wrong_details.wrong: his friends welcome him on the street
wrong_details.true: his friends dread him and flee when they see him on the street

lines.text: David trusts the LORD, says his times are in His hands, and asks that lying lips be rewarded.

wrong_details.wrong: asks that lying lips be rewarded
wrong_details.true: asks that lying lips be silenced

lines.text: David blesses the LORD for loving devotion in a besieged city, and tells all who hope in the LORD to be strong and courageous.
